1. (Currently amended) A method for training a molecular properties model, comprising: obtaining a pseudo-partial ordering of molecules, wherein the pseudo partial ordering includes at least a representation of a first and second molecule, ordered relative to one another and a property of interest; generating a representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules that is appropriate for a selected machine learning algorithm, wherein the representation is generated and stored on a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium; providing the pseudo partial ordering of molecules to the selected machine learning algorithm executed on a processor; and executing the selected machine learning algorithm on the processor using the pseudo partial ordering, wherein executing the selected machine learning algorithm trains a molecular properties model configured to generate a prediction regarding additional molecules supplied to the model.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the molecular properties model generates predictions related to a property of interest selected from at least one of a pharmacokinetic property, pharmacodynamic property, physiological or pharmacological activity, toxicity or selectivity; a chemical property including reactivity, binding affinity, pKa, or a property of a specific atom or bond in a molecule; or a physical property including melting point, solubility, a membrane permeability, and a force-field parameter, wherein the prediction is generated by executing the trained molecular properties model on a processor.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a classification learning algorithm executed on a processor to classify molecules based on the pseudo-partial ordering.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a kernel based learning algorithm executed on a processor.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a variant of a Boosting algorithm, RankBoost algorithm, Alternating Decision Trees algorithm, Support Vector Machines algorithm, a Perceptron algorithm, Winnow, a Hedge Algorithm, decision trees, neural networks, genetic algorithms, genetic programming or any modifications thereof modified to process the pseudo partial ordering of ranked pairs, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm is executed on a processor.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm is executed on a processor and is configured to minimize, either directly or indirectly, a function of the rank ordering of molecules in the pseudo partial ordering.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, further comprising, determining an accuracy of the prediction for the additional molecule by carrying out laboratory experimentation using physically existing samples of the additional molecule, or by performing a research study using physical samples of the additional molecule, wherein the steps of the method are performed using a processor.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein generating the representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules comprises: generating a vector representation of the molecules using a processor, wherein the vector representation is configured to encode the structure of the molecules included the pseudo-partial ordering; or comprises generating an n-point pharmacophore representation of the molecules included in the pseudo-partial ordering using a processor.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein at least two of the molecules in the training set are alternative representations of the same physical molecule and the property of interest is a property of the alternative representations, wherein the method is executed on a processor.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, wherein at least two of the molecules in the training set are encoded to represent different atoms, bonds or substituent groups of the same molecule and the property of interest is a property of the atoms, bonds or substituent groups, wherein the method is executed on a processor.

11. (Currently amended) A non-transitory computer-storage medium containing a program which, when executed by a processor, performs a method for training a molecular properties model, comprising: receiving a pseudo-partial ordering of molecules, wherein the pseudo partial ordering includes at least a representation of a first and second molecule, ordered relative to one another and a property of interest; generating a representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules that is appropriate for a selected machine learning algorithm; providing the pseudo partial ordering of molecules to the selected machine learning algorithm; and executing the selected machine learning algorithm on the processor using the pseudo partial ordering, wherein executing the selected machine learning algorithm trains a molecular properties model configured to generate a prediction regarding additional molecules supplied to the model.
